description.content: Adds a dedicated Claude provider type with an Anthropic Messages form, a per-model adaptive thinking switch, thinking budgets for budget-driven models, paginated Anthropic model discovery that fills recorded capacities for known Claude models, a per-route prompt-cache lifetime, and mixed 5-minute/1-hour cache lifetimes with cache pre-warming.
新增专用的 Claude 提供商类型，提供 Anthropic Messages 表单、逐模型自适应思考开关、预算思考模型的思考 token 预算、分页的 Anthropic 模型探测并为已知 Claude 模型预填录制的容量参数，以及按路由设置的提示缓存时长、分段混合 5 分钟／1 小时缓存时长与缓存预热。
